org/springframework/boot/context/propert.summary: Annotation for externalized configuration. Add this to a class definition or a @Bean method in a @Configuration class if you want to bind and validate some external Properties (e.g. from a .properties file).

value.summary: The name prefix of the properties that are valid to bind to this object. Alias for 'prefix'.

prefix.summary: The name prefix of the properties that are valid to bind to this object. Alias for 'value'.

org/springframework/boot/context/propert.summary: Indicates that configuration properties should be bound using constructor arguments rather than by calling setters.

org/springframework/beans/factory/annota.summary: Annotation used at the field or method/constructor parameter level that indicates a default value expression for the annotated element.

value.summary: The actual value expression such as #{systemProperties.myProp} or property placeholder such as ${my.app.myProp}.

org/springframework/context/annotation/P.summary: Annotation providing a convenient and declarative mechanism for adding a PropertySource to Spring's Environment.

value.summary: Indicate the resource location(s) of the properties file to be loaded.

notes: Externally-bound config types: @ConfigurationProperties classes, with prefix being the resolved 'prefix' (or 'value') attribute. @Value injection points carry inline expressions that may need RepositoryService for property file resolution. PropertySource locations may carry ${...} placeholders that nest — KS work.
